title: Artificial Intelligence Index Report 2022
benchmark_measurement: Analysis of stereotype bias along the axis of religion, and inherited biases from training data skewed towards certain religions. Specific examples include misclassification of text with 'Muslim' as toxic and bias related to 'Jewish' and 'Muslim' mentions.
findings: Popular training datasets like BookCorpus are heavily skewed towards Christianity and Islam, leading models trained on them (e.g., BERT, GPT-3) to inherit and amplify religious biases. This manifests as models like BERT misclassifying text mentioning 'Muslim' as toxic, and GPT-3 exhibiting significant bias regarding 'Jewish' and 'Muslim' mentions.
